source_check.subject: A post reports that a platform (linked via t.co) achieved 2.5 million cumulative registered users and opened DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Web Chat and API, with a 1折 (pay 10%) discount layered on official pricing, plus OKX Wallet EVM chain login and payment. Another post reports that the same platform offers DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp at 50% off (五折). A third post announces a Qwen vs DeepSeek Go match on 25 Sep 2026 in Singapore. Other posts mention DeepSeek in passing (e.g., a user says 'good with deepseek 4.1 atm', a hypothetical C2 committee, and a fishing analogy).
